name: Bükkszentkereszt (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bükkszentkereszt (a crowned red shield with a cross and a wall, within a green wreath) above the name Bükkszentkereszt in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
